title: EMP DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Donna Berg-Lyons
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.nutdewn
materials: Pipet samples “up and down” to mix.

steps.title: Prepare Solution C5‑D with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 100 % ethanol to Solution C5‑D (120 mL for the 4‑prep kit or 360 mL for the 12‑prep kit), mix well, and place a check mark in the “ethanol added” box on the bottle cap label.

steps.title: Pellet beads in Bead Plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the PowerSoil‑htp Bead Plate for 1 min at 2500 × g to pellet the beads.

steps.title: Remove Square Well Mat
steps.instruction: Take the Square Well Mat off the PowerSoil‑htp Bead Plate and set it aside.

steps.title: Add soil sample
steps.instruction: Add 0.1–0.25 g soil (or a swab) to each well; the plate can be stored at 4 °C covered with the Square Well Mat.

steps.title: Add bead solution
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL PowerSoil‑htp Bead Solution to each well of the Bead Plate.

steps.title: Prepare Solution C1
steps.instruction: If Solution C1 has precipitated, heat it at 60 °C until the precipitate dissolves; the solution may be used while still warm.

steps.title: Add Solution C1 and secure mat
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL Solution C1 to each well and tightly secure the Square Well Mat to the plate.

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Place the sealed plate in a 65 °C water bath (do not submerge) for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Mount plate on shaker
steps.instruction: Place the Bead Plate between the aluminum plate adapters and securely fasten it to the 96‑well plate shaker.

steps.title: Shake plate
steps.instruction: Shake at speed 20 for 20 minutes, ensuring the plate does not rub against any surfaces in the shaker.

steps.title: First centrifugation and add C2
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate at room temperature for 6 minutes at 4500 × g; while centrifuging, aliquot 250 µL Solution C2 into each well of Plate #1 and cover with sealing tape (tape can be reused).

steps.title: Discard Square Well Mat
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the Square Well Mat from the Bead Plate.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to Plate #1
steps.instruction: Remove sealing tape from Plate #1, transfer ~400–500 µL supernatant from the Bead Plate to Plate #1, pipette up/down 4 times, re‑apply sealing tape, and incubate at 4 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge Plate #1 and add C3
steps.instruction: Centrifuge Plate #1 at room temperature for 6 minutes at 4500 × g; while centrifuging, add 200 µL Solution C3 to each well of Plate #3 and cover with sealing tape.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to Plate #2
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, discard sealing tape from Plate #1, transfer the entire supernatant (~600 µL) to Plate #2, apply sealing tape, and centrifuge at room temperature for 6 minutes at 4500 × g.

steps.title: Transfer to Plate #3
steps.instruction: Remove sealing tape from Plate #2 and Plate #3, transfer the entire supernatant (~600 µL) from Plate #2 to Plate #3, pipette up/down 4 times, re‑apply sealing tape, and incubate at 4 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge Plate #3
steps.instruction: Centrifuge Plate #3 at room temperature for 6 minutes at 4500 × g, then discard the sealing tape.

steps.title: Transfer to Plate #4
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire supernatant (~750 µL) from Plate #3 to Plate #4, apply sealing tape, and centrifuge at room temperature for 6 minutes at 4500 × g while adding 650 µL Solution C4 to each well of Plate #5.

steps.title: Move supernatant to Plate #5
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 650 µL of supernatant from Plate #4 to Plate #5, then add a second 650 µL of Solution C4 (total 1300 µL C4 per well). Store the plate at 4 °C covered with sealing tape; briefly centrifuge after overnight storage to collect any condensate.

steps.title: Load Spin Plate
steps.instruction: Place the Spin Plate onto Plate #6, load ~650 µL from each well of Plate #5 into the Spin Plate wells, and apply centrifuge tape.

steps.title: First spin of Spin Plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at room temperature for 5 minutes at 4500 × g, discard the flow‑through, return the Spin Plate to Plate #6, and remove and discard the centrifuge tape.

steps.title: Repeat spin until supernatant exhausted
steps.instruction: Repeat the 5‑minute spin, discard flow‑through, and replace the Spin Plate until all supernatant has been processed; discard the final flow‑through.

steps.title: Add Solution C5‑D
steps.instruction: Confirm ethanol was added to Solution C5‑D (step 1), add 500 µL Solution C5‑D to each well of the Spin Plate, and apply centrifuge tape.

steps.title: Spin with C5‑D
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at room temperature for 5 minutes at 4500 × g, discard the flow‑through, and return the Spin Plate to Plate #6.

steps.title: Second C5‑D spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at room temperature for 6 minutes at 4500 × g.

steps.title: Transfer Spin Plate to Microplate
steps.instruction: Place the Spin Plate onto the Microplate, remove and discard the centrifuge tape.

steps.title: Add Solution C6
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Solution C6 to the center of each Spin Plate well, apply centrifuge tape, and let sit on the filter for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Final spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at room temperature for 7 minutes at 4500 × g, then remove and discard the centrifuge tape.

steps.title: Seal and store DNA
steps.instruction: Cover the Microplate wells with the provided Elution Sealing Mat; DNA is ready for downstream applications. Store at –20 °C or –80 °C (avoid prolonged storage at 4 °C). Note that Solution C6 contains no EDTA; see the troubleshooting guide for DNA concentration if needed.
